items.question: What is Platzi Extension?
items.answer: Platzi Extension is an open-source browser extension that adds keyboard shortcuts, an augmented search bar, an SSH mode, and other productivity tools to your Platzi experience.

items.question: Is Platzi Extension free?
items.answer: Yes, Platzi Extension is completely free and open source.

items.question: Which browsers does Platzi Extension support?
items.answer: Platzi Extension works on Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, and Safari.

items.question: Does Platzi Extension collect my personal data?
items.answer: No. Platzi Extension does not collect any personal information, as detailed in its privacy policy.

items.question: Is Platzi Extension an official Platzi product?
items.answer: No, Platzi Extension is an independent open-source community project and is not officially affiliated with Platzi.

items.question: How do I install Platzi Extension?
items.answer: Click the Install button at the top of this page and follow the instructions for your browser.
